universe: Course growth_tech selection with NVDA eligible in both arms
veto: Three valid positive centers and valid DCF band. Weighted center strictly below 0.85 times prior close AND max/min central value <= K. Missing evidence abstains.
weights: Equal thirds normally. If DCF width/center exceeds same-week eligible 75th percentile, DCF 1/6, peer 5/12, own history 5/12.
reference: Course selection-only scores, weights, weekly execution, costs; no timing overlay
primary: Net CAGR difference in percentage points, measured by course performance methodology
uncertainty: Paired circular 20-session blocks, 5000 draws, seed 20261124 (original weighted study protocol).
selection_context: K chosen on development data. Earlier experiments using other specifications have used this historical validation split.
